command:
bash -s <<'AUTORL_RUN'
set -euo pipefail
# Harbor inlines root run specs before the Issue verifier as well.
if [[ ${AUTORLBENCH_EVALUATION_LEVEL:-} == issue && ${AUTORLBENCH_TASK_ROOT:-} == /tests ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
mkdir -p "$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/experiment_logs" && bash run_grpo.sh
AUTORL_RUN
